name: autodevops-bridge
description: GPT-GitHub-VPS automated development agent for auditable coding, CI, deployment, diagnostics, and rollback workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Automate development from GPT to GitHub and VPS
interface.longDescription: Connect GPT, GitHub, and VPS infrastructure through bounded MCP tools and auditable workflows. Inspect projects, develop through branches and pull requests, run CI, deploy with VSR or GHS, verify production, collect sanitized diagnostics, and perform confirmed rollback without exposing unrestricted shell access to the model.
defaultPrompt: Inspect my registered projects, recent CI, production health, deployed SHA, and configured VSR or GHS mode.
Implement this requirement on a branch, add tests, run CI, review the diff, and open a pull request without changing production.
Deploy the reviewed main branch to the VPS using the project's configured VSR or GHS mode, then verify the deployed SHA and health.
Diagnose the latest failed deployment using only sanitized bounded diagnostics and propose a forward fix.
Prepare a rollback, explain the application and database risks, and wait for the literal ROLLBACK confirmation.
